## What happened?

Describe the result and what you expected.

## How can I reproduce it?

Include the command or desktop steps, JarCheck version, operating system and Python version. Say whether recursive scanning was enabled.

## Small example or report

If possible, use a synthetic ZIP/JAR rather than uploading a real mod. Remove usernames, local paths and other private details from reports. Do not upload access tokens, private logs or copyrighted mod JARs.
